faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What documents do I need to rent a vehicle?
faq.a1: A valid driver's license (held for at least one year), a passport or national ID, and a credit or debit card for the deposit. International visitors should bring their passport and, where required, an International Driving Permit.
faq.a2: Yes — every rental includes baseline insurance coverage. The deposit amount and coverage details are listed on each vehicle's page before you reserve.
faq.a3: Yes, subject to the vehicle's availability. Contact us before your return date and we'll do our best to extend your booking.
faq.a4: Vehicles are provided with a full tank and should be returned with a full tank, unless otherwise agreed at pickup.
faq.a5: Most vehicles include unlimited mileage — shown on each vehicle's specification page. Where a daily limit applies, it's listed there too.
faq.q6: How do I cancel or modify a reservation?
faq.a6: Contact us as soon as possible via phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form. Cancellation terms depend on how close to the pickup date you cancel.
